summary: Site 568 (King St cycleway) has Ecocounter 239 from 2012 to 2023 with several multi-week to eight-month outages published as zeros, dump/garbage records around failures (2014, 2023), four doubled days in 2022, and scattered single-record glitches (255 sentinels, a five-hour 14000-bike fault on 2017-02-04). Metrocount 366 ran at site 547 then site 568 from 2026-02-16 with no level change, so each of its directions is one series across both sites. The two counters are kept as separate series because of the 2.7-year gap and different level.
